shared.text: Welcome to Melody and Barnaby's Music Nuggets!
See you for the next Nugget!

clips.text: Hello, <break time="0.3s" /> parents, <break time="0.3s" /> teachers <break time="0.3s" /> and helpers!
Here, children learn to read music, <break time="0.5s" /> one small idea at a time.
clips.show: Here, children learn to read music, one small idea at a time.

clips.text: Each Nugget is a short video, <break time="0.5s" /> with a game to practise it.
clips.show: Each Nugget is a short video, with a game to practise it.

clips.text: No sign-up. <break time="0.6s" /> No adverts. <break time="0.6s" /> Everything here is free, <break time="0.4s" /> and it stays free.
clips.show: No sign-up. No adverts. Everything here is free, and it stays free.

clips.text: The Nuggets go in order, <break time="0.5s" /> so each one builds on the last.
clips.show: The Nuggets go in order, so each one builds on the last.

clips.text: Rhythm, <break time="0.4s" /> notes, <break time="0.4s" /> melody, <break time="0.4s" /> scales <break time="0.4s" /> and harmony, <break time="0.5s" /> all growing together.
clips.show: Rhythm, notes, melody, scales and harmony, all growing together.

clips.text: A new Nugget arrives <break time="0.5s" /> every Wednesday <break time="0.4s" /> and Saturday.
clips.show: A new Nugget arrives every Wednesday and Saturday.

clips.text: Made for children aged four to seven, <break time="0.5s" /> and the grown-ups who help them.
clips.show: Made for children aged four to seven, and the grown-ups who help them.

clips.text: To find the games, <break time="0.4s" /> use the link <break time="0.4s" /> in each video's description.
clips.show: To find the games, use the link in each video's description.

clips.text: Or type this address <break time="0.5s" /> into any browser.
clips.show: Or type this address into any browser.

clips.text: Subscribe, <break time="0.5s" /> and every new Nugget <break time="0.4s" /> will be waiting in your Subscriptions.
clips.show: Subscribe, and every new Nugget will be waiting in your Subscriptions.
